'''Mestare''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where unique [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] were mined. It was said that [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] which utilized these crystals could cut through [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], a lightsaber-resistant metal. The unique crystals were also known to make the lightsaber blades curved, similar to ancient [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|Jedi katanas]]. Mestare Jedi also wore protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for an unknown reason.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''Clone Wars Adventures'', the Ancient Mestare Jedi outfit was available for players to buy. It appeared similar to [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] armor.

[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Mestare was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
